title: HighTide's Material Bits
description: A mod for Minecraft Java Edition that adds some new items named "Bits" that are compacted versions of nuggets and non nuggetable materials (eg; diamond, emerald, copper, and netherite).
body:
## What Is It?
**HighTide's Material Bits** is a Minecraft Java mod that adds many new items that are named "Bits". These items are one step lower than the lowest crafting point for any material in Minecraft. These could be:
- Iron Nugget > Iron Bit
- Gold Nugget > Gold Bit
- Diamond > Diamond Bit
